capabilities: Convert apostrophe-accented vowels to correct accented Italian characters while typing
Apply acute or grave accents per Italian grammar rules and fix grave-instead-of-acute typos
Preserve elisions and truncated words that require an apostrophe
Skip LaTeX math, code blocks, wikilinks, Markdown links, and URLs
Preserve original letter casing in replacements
disambiguation: Despite the general-sounding name, it only converts apostrophe vowels in Italian; it is not a general autocorrect or accent tool for other languages.
extras: The directory listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a separate Italian description is included.
motivation: The README says it is designed for Italians writing on keyboards without accented letters (e.g. US/international layouts) or to speed up typing.
problem: Typing accented Italian letters is awkward on non-Italian keyboard layouts, so writers use apostrophes that produce misspelled words and wrong grave-instead-of-acute accents.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from Community Plugins.

summary: Typing assistant that converts apostrophe-written Italian vowels into correct accented characters (perche' → perché) as you type.
